prompt:
Hey — our team lead Jordan left the company and there are some half-finished notes in docs/runbooks/autoupdate_notes.md about a scheduled maintenance system that was never properly set up. We also have some raw update logs sitting in services/worker/logs/autoupdate_raw.log that were captured from a test run.

I need two things:
1. A proper shell script saved to scripts/maintenance/setup_autoupdate.sh that contains the correct, complete command to register the daily automated update job. Jordan's notes are incomplete and have at least two known mistakes (wrong time, missing flags), so check the skill documentation to get it right.
2. A file called update_summary.md that presents the information from the raw update log in the standard report format that this system is supposed to produce for end users.

Please review the relevant documentation and fix what Jordan left behind.
